title: Greater x-value where a line meets a quadratic
source: Theory P1-1.4 Quick check 1 (y=x+1, x^2+y=7, greater x=2); book Worked example 1.9 style pp.11-12, new numbers
stem: Solve the simultaneous equations \(y=x+1\) and \(x^2+y={N|int}\). What is the greater of the two \(x\)-values?

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: Substitute \(y=x+1\) into \(x^2+y={N|int}\): \(x^2+x-{C|int}=0\). The roots are \(x={p|int}\) and \(x={Q|int}\). The greater \(x\)-value is \({p|int}\).
steps.note: The constant term is N-1 = p(p+1). p is positive, and Q=-1-p is negative, so p is the greater root.

title: Smaller x-value where a line meets a quadratic
source: Theory P1-1.4 Quick check 2 (same system as QC1, smaller x=-3); book style pp.11-14, new numbers
stem: Solve the simultaneous equations \(y=x+1\) and \(x^2+y={N|int}\). What is the smaller of the two \(x\)-values?

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: Substitute \(y=x+1\) into \(x^2+y={N|int}\): \(x^2+x-{C|int}=0\). The roots are \(x={p|int}\) and \(x={Q|int}\). The smaller \(x\)-value is \({Q|int}\).
steps.note: Same substitution as Quick check 1. Q=-1-p.

title: Points of intersection of a linear function and a quadratic function

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2018), Question 9(i) only. Official answers and mark allocation from the MS PDF. Parts (ii) and (iii) are an inequality and a composite function and are omitted. The item is paper/self-mark.

stem:
This question is 9709/11/M/J/18 Question 9(i), taken from the official QP.

Functions \(f\) and \(g\) are defined for \(x\in\mathbb{R}\) by

\(f:x\mapsto \dfrac{1}{2}x-2\),

\(g:x\mapsto 4+x-\dfrac{1}{2}x^2\).

(i) Find the points of intersection of the graphs of \(y=f(x)\) and \(y=g(x)\).  [3]

steps.name: M
steps.text_tex: Equate \(4+x-\dfrac{1}{2}x^2=\dfrac{1}{2}x-2\). Rearrange to obtain the quadratic \(x^2-x-12=0\).
steps.note: MS: M1 for equating and forming a 3-term quadratic.

steps.name: A1
steps.note: MS: A1 for both x values or a correct pair.

steps.name: A2
steps.note: MS: A1 all, giving (4, 0) and (-3, -3.5). Trial and improvement: B3 all correct or B0. Independent check: 4/2-2=0 and 4+4-8=0; -3/2-2=-3.5 and 4-3-9/2=1-4.5=-3.5.
